title: Cognitive Impairment and Balance in Elderly
brief_summary: One important issue in older adults with cognitive problems is the higher risk of fall due to decreased motor function and balance. The objective of this study is to evaluate the repercussions of mild cognitive impairment in balance in elderly.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Nursing home residents.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Surgery on lower limbs.
* Traumatic damage on lower limbs.
* Severe cognitive impairment in order not to complete the assessment.
